deploy-bot: ALERT: canary /chat/generate p95 +32% vs baseline for 6m. Autorevert candidate -> v4.0.1. Actions: rollback canary, throttle, ignore. https://telemetry.internal/alerts/1745553333

anya: EU canary is noisy. Support seeing increased 504s.

troy: threshold set at 20%. This is sustained. Autorevert configured but operator approval required for canary slices.

sam: prefer targeted rollback of eu-chat route only. Throttling could cascade.

mika: agree. Proposed command (holding 60s):
```
releases rollback --to v4.0.1 --scope canary --selectors region=eu,route=chat --reason "p95 spike"
```

legal-bot: note: capture audit_id and do not phrase customer message as "bug introduced" without engineering confirmation.

anya: go for it. I'll draft the internal and customer short note.

troy: executing now. tail:
```
$ releases rollback --to v4.0.1 --scope canary --selectors region=eu,route=chat --reason "p95 spike"
Rolling back canary eu/chat to v4.0.1...
- drain -> OK
- update routing -> OK
- verify -> p95 back to baseline (50s)
Rollback complete. audit_id=rb-20240615-7712
```

sam: telemetry shows p95 normalized. Support comms sent to impacted tickets.

mika: created ENG-8120 for bisect and hotfix plan, attaching audit_id and logs. Keep prod pinned.

anya: thanks. Closing thread once ENG-8120 has owner.

deploy-bot: NOTE: autorevert suppressed by operator override at execution time.
